headword: {権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう
gloss: to wield power; to exercise authority

definitions.gloss: to wield power; to exercise authority
definitions.explanation: To actively use the power or authority one holds, often with a connotation of forceful or overbearing use. Frequently has a negative nuance when describing abuse of power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{独裁者|どくさいしゃ}→独裁者：15406_dokusaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう。
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: It is not acceptable for a boss to wield power over subordinates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中枢|ちゅうすう}→中枢：11373_chuusuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るってきた⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ついに⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The politician who had wielded power at the heart of the government for many years finally announced his resignation.

notes:
A set expression using ⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ (to wield, to brandish, to exercise). ⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ is used in Japanese to describe actively and forcefully bringing something into use — it is also seen in collocations like ⟦{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう→腕を振るう：07452_udewofuruu⟧ (to show off one's skill) and ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ (to muster courage). When paired with ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧, it frequently carries a negative connotation, suggesting an overbearing or oppressive use of authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう: to wield power
- ⟦{絶大|ぜつだい}→絶大：13888_zetsudai⟧な{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう: to wield enormous power
- ⟦{弱者|じゃくしゃ}→弱者：12535_jakusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう: to wield power over the weak
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}りかざす: to brandish one's authority — stronger, more negative nuance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to seize/hold power — emphasizes gaining and holding, not necessarily using
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise power — more neutral, formal; often legal or institutional
- ⟦{支配|しはい}する→支配する：25222_shihaisuru⟧: to rule, to dominate — broader, focused on the state of control
